name: Single Sign-On (SSO) MUST be used where possible to reduce password fatigue and simplify the adoption of MFA.
requirementTitle: Single Sign-On (SSO) MUST be used where possible to reduce password fatigue and simplify the adoption of MFA.
requirementDescription: Users should sign in once with their organisational account (for example, their DfE Entra ID/Microsoft 365 account) and then be able to access approved systems without managing separate usernames and passwords for each application.
why: Better security. instead of 20 apps and 20 passwords we have 1 identity and 1 MFA process. Better governance means one someone leaves the ID is disabled and access is removed everywhere
tasks: Single Sign-On (SSO) MUST be used where possible to reduce password fatigue and simplify the adoption of MFA.

actions.title: Single Sign-On (SSO) MUST be used where possible to reduce password fatigue and simplify the adoption of MFA.
actions.description: Wherever possible, applications should use the organisation's central identity provider (such as Microsoft Entra ID) rather than separate usernames and passwords
